reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki Config: Better configuration defaults to provide a better experience for users out of the box", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changed several configuration defaults, so installations that rely on default values may behave differently after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Read PR 10793 to see which defaults changed. Set any of those values explicitly if you depend on the old behaviour.

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 changed several configuration defaults (PR 10793), but the evidence does not say which ones; setups that rely on defaults may behave differently.
